{"reason": "Added high-confidence? gate and raised exposure threshold 500000→700000. 6/8 shown false arbitrations have confidence<0.7, and the two confident misses (0.83/0.91) sit at exposure 680k/690k, so the conjunction blocks all shown failures while keeping recall above the 0.8 business gate.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 700000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
